description: This file defines a wizard interface for generating a third-party ledger report in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including form layout, default values, validation, and report selection logic.

classes.name: wizard_report
classes.description: A wizard interface class for generating third-party ledger reports with methods for defaults, validation, and report selection.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for the report form, including fiscal year, company, and periods.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Determines which report to generate based on user input (page split or not).

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that the selected date range falls within a fiscal year.

methods.name: _check_state
methods.description: Validates form state, date range, and checks for open invoices before proceeding.
